summary: Organization members can request Cloud Marketplace SaaS products for procurement.
extended_definition: Organization members can request Cloud Marketplace SaaS products for procurement.

supporting_pages.title: "Manage requests to add products to your private marketplace \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Your users can request to add Cloud Marketplace products to your organization's private marketplace, if the following are true: You're using Google Cloud Private Marketplace to manage which products your users can view and use.
Review an access request Accounts with the required roles for an organization can view all of that organization's access requests, and can complete or deny requests.
You can access this from the email, or view all access requests by opening the Marketplace governance page and then clicking Manage access requests .

supporting_pages.title: "Organization governance for Google Cloud Marketplace \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Procurement requests You can use procurement requests to let your users request that you assess and authorize products for use within your organization.
Google Cloud Marketplace gives you ways to manage your organization's procurement of Cloud Marketplace products.
For more information, see Manage procurement requests .

supporting_pages.title: "Access Google Cloud Private Marketplace \_|\_ Google Cloud Marketplace \_\
evidence_snippets: Request products that you want to use If your organization's administrators have turned on Cloud Marketplace Product Requests, you can ask your administrators to review and approve Google Cloud Marketplace products and offer them in your organization's private marketplace.
Your organization's administrators curate products available on Google Cloud Marketplace that meet your organization's internal procurement standards, and then share the products with you.
Your membership in an organization, folder, or project determines which products are available for your use in Google Cloud Private Marketplace.

supporting_pages.title: "Managing billing for Cloud Marketplace products \_|\_ Google Cloud Marketplace\
evidence_snippets: Viewing your purchases You can view purchased Google Cloud Marketplace software as a service (SaaS) products and any products with an accepted private offer that are linked to your billing account on the Your Orders page.
Managing billing plans When you purchase a commercial Kubernetes app or SaaS product in Google Cloud Marketplace, you must select a billing plan on behalf of your organization.
After setting up a billing plan, you can make the product available to users in your organization so that they can deploy it.
